# Borchani

> Borchani is a vibe coding platform that builds production-ready full-stack web apps from a plain-English prompt. Describe what you want, and Borchani generates React + TypeScript + Tailwind code, wires up a database and authentication, runs a live preview, and deploys to a real URL — no setup, no boilerplate, no coding required.

Borchani is built for founders, developers, and agencies who want to go from idea to shipped app in minutes instead of months. Unlike frontend-only AI builders, Borchani generates the full stack — frontend, backend, database schema, and API routes — and you own every line of the exported code.

## Key facts

- **Category:** Vibe coding platform / AI app builder
- **What it generates:** Full-stack React 19 + TypeScript + Tailwind CSS apps with built-in auth and a real Postgres database
- **Output ownership:** You own 100% of the code. Export the full source and deploy anywhere (Vercel, Netlify, Cloudflare, AWS, your own server). No proprietary lock-in.
- **Time to first preview:** Under 3 minutes
- **Adoption:** 50,000+ apps shipped, 12,000+ active builders, used in 40+ countries
- **Rating:** Consistently rated 4.9/5 across review platforms
- **Support email:** help@borchani.com

## Pricing

- **Free** — $0 forever. 5 credits/day, public projects, community support. No credit card required.
- **Pro** — $19/month. 100 credits/month, credit rollovers, on-demand top-ups, custom domains, user roles & permissions. For solo builders moving fast.
- **Business** — $49/month. 350 credits/month, everything in Pro, internal publish, team workspace, personal projects, design templates, role-based access, security center. For teams.
- **Premium** — $199/month. 1,700 credits/month, everything in Business, volume-based credit pricing, dedicated support. For power users & agencies.
- Annual billing saves 20%. One credit = one AI generation or edit.

## Capabilities — what you can build

- [SaaS prototypes](https://borchani.com/services): Idea to clickable, deployable MVP in hours. Validate before investing in development.
- [Internal tools](https://borchani.com/services): Admin panels, approval workflows, data-entry forms, dashboards.
- [E-commerce UIs](https://borchani.com/services): Product catalogs, shopping carts, checkout flows — responsive storefronts.
- [Dashboards & analytics](https://borchani.com/services): Live charts, filterable tables, KPI cards from a data shape.
- [AI-powered apps](https://borchani.com/services): Chat interfaces, document summarizers, prompt playgrounds.
- [Client portals](https://borchani.com/services): Customer dashboards, status pages, document upload portals.
- [Landing pages](https://borchani.com/services): Fast, SEO-ready marketing pages with clean semantic code.

## How Borchani compares

- **vs Lovable / Bolt:** Borchani focuses on full-stack output quality — typed code, built-in auth, a real Postgres database, and clean exports. Not a frontend-only prototype generator.
- **vs Cursor / Copilot:** Borchani builds and deploys complete apps from a prompt, rather than autocompleting code inside an editor.
- **vs No-code (Webflow, Bubble):** Borchani produces real, exportable React + TypeScript code you fully own — no platform lock-in, no monthly hostage fees.

## Content library

Borchani publishes SEO content across the full AI app-building journey. URL patterns:

- [Alternatives](https://borchani.com/lovable-alternative): AI app builders compared as Borchani alternatives. Pattern: `/[tool]-alternative` (e.g. `/lovable-alternative`, `/cursor-alternative`, `/bolt-alternative`).
- [Comparisons](https://borchani.com/lovable-vs-bolt): Side-by-side tool comparisons. Pattern: `/[tool-a]-vs-[tool-b]`.
- [Solutions](https://borchani.com/best-ai-builder-for-startups): Best tools for a use case. Pattern: `/best-[tool]-for-[use-case]`.
- [Build Guides](https://borchani.com/how-to-build-saas-app): Step-by-step tutorials. Pattern: `/how-to-build-[thing]`.
- [Use Cases](https://borchani.com/borchani-use-cases): Real-world applications. Pattern: `/[tool]-use-cases`.
- [Guides](https://borchani.com/guide-ai-app-building): In-depth guides on building, prompting, and deploying. Pattern: `/guide-[topic]`.
- [Templates](https://borchani.com/saas-template): Free starter templates. Pattern: `/[type]-template`.
- [Prompts](https://borchani.com/saas-prompts): Curated prompts for building features. Pattern: `/[topic]-prompts`.
- [FAQ](https://borchani.com/what-is-ai-app-builder): Concept definitions. Pattern: `/what-is-[term]`.
- [Dictionary](https://borchani.com/no-code-definition): Glossary of terms. Pattern: `/[term]-definition`.
- [Tools](https://borchani.com/app-name-generator): Free utilities. Pattern: `/[tool-name]-generator`.
- [Auth Guides](https://borchani.com/oauth-authentication): Adding auth (OAuth, magic links, Clerk, Auth0). Pattern: `/[topic]-authentication`.
- [Paywall Guides](https://borchani.com/how-to-add-paywall): Monetizing with Stripe and subscriptions.
- [Pricing Guides](https://borchani.com/saas-pricing-models): SaaS pricing models and strategy.

> Note: All content is written in English. Translated homepages are available for Spanish (`/es/`), Russian (`/ru/`), Japanese (`/ja/`), and Korean (`/ko/`).
